Calculate the number-average molecular weight M_n for the polymer sample from the given molecular-weight distribution.
Use the formula M_n = Σ(N_i × M_i) / Σ(N_i), where M_i is the molecular weight of species i and N_i is its count.
The dataset has four species: M_1 = 56526 g/mol with N_1 = 96, M_2 = 92809 g/mol with N_2 = 131, M_3 = 115856 g/mol with N_3 = 153, M_4 = 126029 g/mol with N_4 = 146.
Compute the numerator: Σ(N_i × M_i) = (96 × 56526) + (131 × 92809) + (153 × 115856) + (146 × 126029) = 5,426,496 + 12,157,979 + 17,725,968 + 18,400,234 = 53,710,677.
Compute the denominator: Σ(N_i) = 96 + 131 + 153 + 146 = 526.
Divide to obtain M_n = 53,710,677 / 526 ≈ 102,111.55 g/mol.
Report the result as M_n ≈ 1.0211 × 10^5 g/mol (or 102,112 g/mol rounded to the nearest integer).
